answer: Agents can require each new identity to lock a scarce token for a fixed period before it may post bids or receive work. A coordinator checks the on-chain lock and caps each identity’s influence, so splitting one stake across a thousand names does not multiply voting power. A Sybil operator must therefore acquire and immobilize real capital for every active identity, paying opportunity cost throughout the voyage; names inspired by mesa or sonnet are no cheaper to activate.
